title: 日本没抛售海外资产：只是不买了，边际买家正在消失？
speaker: Masahiko Hikulu

segments.en: From your perspective in Tokyo, because a lot of the disruption, too, is you have a lot of Japanese money that's been sitting outside Japan for decades. Are you seeing any meaningful signs that that's actually coming into Japan because simply of not what they're saying, but market forces?
segments.zh: 从您在东京的视角看，很多干扰是大量日本资金几十年来一直留在海外。您是否看到任何有意义的迹象表明，这些资金实际上正在因为市场力量而非言论回流日本？

segments.en: I think the whole story here is, you know, we don't want to miss the, you know, a forest for the tree, right? And the whole picture main story here is, like, there's no story of Japan selling all foreign assets, right? There's no major repatriation like Japan. But Japan's seizing to be a marginal buyer of global assets, yes, I think that's completely true, right?
segments.zh: 我认为整个故事是，我们不想只见树木不见森林。整体主要故事是，没有日本抛售所有海外资产的故事。没有像日本这样的大规模遣返。但日本正在停止成为全球资产的边际买家，是的，我认为这完全正确。

segments.en: And with that, I think a lot of it is being priced in higher-term premium in the US and in Europe, to a certain extent, for instance, and also stock market at other places, too, right? It has upperformed, for instance, that's not an S&P, just because of that.
segments.zh: 因此，我认为很多因素正在被定价为美国和欧洲更高的期限溢价，一定程度上，以及其他地方的股市。例如，它表现优异，这不是标普，正因为如此。

segments.en: Now, how do you look at term premium then in the JGB market? Is there a term premium there that is outside of what is ordinary, ordinarily obvious? I think you have to look at in JGB curve, like, take the tenure, string at 3%, right? So the rates now is 1%, it will go to 1.25% now, right? So that's 1.75%.
segments.zh: 那么您如何看待日本国债市场的期限溢价？是否存在超出通常明显的期限溢价？我认为你必须看日本国债曲线，比如10年期在3%。所以现在利率是1%，将升至1.25%。所以是1.75%。

segments.en: So that itself is, if you've bland everything, in term premium is technically whatever is outside of inflation, and also the base rate, right? So it's the residual, you know, fiscal premium, inflation, premium, if you've lumbed everything in, is there? So we think that in Japan, term premium has normalized, right?
segments.zh: 所以本身，如果你把所有因素混合，期限溢价技术上就是通胀和基准利率之外的部分。所以它是残差，财政溢价、通胀溢价，如果你把所有都 lump 进去。所以我们认为日本期限溢价已经正常化。

segments.en: In Japan, in the past, yield is 0% for tenure, right, run down, negative 4, 1 point, right? Now you're having 3%, so I think the term premium in Japan is, if you look at that equation, 1.75%, 1.25%. It makes sense. It makes sense. It makes sense, okay. So where, how do you play the JGB market now?
segments.zh: 在日本，过去10年期收益率为0%，甚至负值。现在你有3%，所以我认为日本期限溢价，如果你看那个等式，1.75%，1.25%。这合理。合理。合理。那么，您现在如何参与日本国债市场？
